run_evolution: run an evolution loop on a Python program using a custom evaluator and config
evolve_function: evolve a Python function by providing test cases and letting the optimizer improve it
evolve_algorithm: evolve a class-based algorithm by providing a benchmark function that scores instances
evolve_code: evolve arbitrary Python code strings using a custom evaluator function
prepare_program_and_evaluator: prepare a program file and evaluator from code strings, files, or callable functions
